captions.detailed: This 3D model features a solar observation refractor telescope mounted on a detailed alt-azimuth head and supported by a dark, lightweight tripod. The telescope tube is primarily white with a dark grey dew shield, a prominent orange-tinted solar filter at the front aperture, and a rear eyepiece assembly. The alt-azimuth mount is rendered in light grey with dark adjustment knobs, allowing the telescope to pivot on a horizontal altitude axis and rotate on a vertical azimuth axis. The tripod consists of three dark grey legs with rubberized feet and a central spreader brace for stability.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a solar observation refractor telescope on a tripod. The assembly should include a three-legged tripod with a central spreader, a dual-axis alt-azimuth mount with fine-adjustment knobs, and a telescope tube complete with a front solar filter, a mounting collar, and an eyepiece assembly. Apply appropriate materials such as white and dark grey plastics/metals for the body, and a translucent orange material for the solar filter.
captions.factory: The code defines a multi-part articulated assembly using custom geometric wrappers. It models the tripod legs and spreader using cylinders and boxes rotated into position, then mounts a central base. On top of this base, an azimuth joint rotates a cylindrical head. An altitude joint connects the head to a rectangular mounting bracket holding the main telescope tube (constructed from concentric cylinders for the main body, dew shield, and solar filter). Additional small cylinders and boxes are used to construct the fine-adjust knobs and the eyepiece assembly.
